Actual helper owns ScDocumentPool and ScStyleSheetPool on the existing shared style base. SourceDocumentGone clears the actual style-pool source pointer;managed references retain physical identity without a global reference-count simulator. CellAttributeHelper is allocated lazily and rejects unshared clipboard/undo access as native assertions require. Real document NoListening and formula change-track membership flags preserve native start/end subscription asymmetry after group teardown. Tests use genuine documents,resources and listeners. Existing normal-document shell/export/test consumers explicitly borrow the known owned pool at original dereference boundaries;nullable document API remains honest. Calc style creation/copy factories explicitly reject unsupported ScStyleSheet construction rather than creating the wrong shared style type. Standard-style population,formatter/edit-engine services,clipboard resource sharing/reset/paste belong outside this consumed allocation/lifetime slice. Full closure/raw100 and broad native parity remain pending.
